summary: W4: wire the POS connector + pre-bills into the hot paths (completion, refunds, cancels, receipts, payments), manager-only voids, delete direct FBR/SRB filing; then three-lens adversarial review and a fix pass

built.summary:
W4 hot-path cutover is done and the full backend suite passes: 100 files, 1397 passed, 4 skipped. `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean.

What changed:

(1) **index.ts**
- Registers `registerConnectorPlugins(api)` and `registerPreBillPlugins(api)` under /api/v1.
- Under ENABLE_WORKERS it runs `drainLegacyTaxQueues()` first; the fiscal and terminal connector workers start in its `.finally`, so a failed drain never blocks them.
- The FBR/SRB worker starts and GET /integrations/tax/status are gone.
- /health now reports `fiscalConnector`, `cardTerminal` and `connectorSecretKey` (each `ok`/`warn`/`off`, never an error) and `whatsappKeyAtRest`. The checks type was widened to allow `off`.
- The upload-storage check was already there.
- `applyModuleGrants` now runs at boot (fix-W2 item 1).

(2) **completeOrder** (orders/service.ts)
- Inside the `order.complete` claim transaction it calls `enqueueFiscalSaleTx`, the only sale filer. It returns null when the company's fiscal reporting is off (§17.7).
- In the same transaction it calls `markPreBillsConvertedTx`.
- Refunds taken before completion (a line voided on a paid order still in the kitchen) are queued behind the sale, so their return files once the sale has its number.
- Both outbox writes run behind a SAVEPOINT. If one fails, the sale and its ledger, loyalty and notice still go through, and an ExceptionFlag of kind `fiscal_failed` is raised instead of failing silently. A test forces a real database error to prove this.
- After commit: `submitFiscalAtTill` when `syncFiscal` is set (till payments), otherwise `kickFiscal`. It returns `{ ran, fiscal }`.
- `submitSrbForReceipt`, `SrbReceipt` and the FBR/SRB queue adds are removed. The TaxInvoice is still issued as before.

(3) **Refunds**
- `refundOrder` inserts a fiscal refund document in the same transaction as the negative Payment (`enqueueFiscalRefundTx`), kicks it after commit, and returns `fiscalRefund`. `srbReturnInvoiceNo` is now always null.
- The full tender amount is passed; `buildRefundPayload` takes the tip out of the taxable return pro rata. The TILL-R4 test now checks the document: lines + tax + service = 594, tip 200 kept separate.
- A cancelled-ticket hand-back files nothing, except when the order had a direct SRB/FBR number from before the cutover. Then it creates a `manual_required` document plus a `fiscal_manual_refund` flag.
- The whole SRB return path is deleted.
- When an order reaches `refunded`, a `void:<orderId>` document covers any part of the sale the refund documents don't already return. It is skipped when that remainder is 0.

(4) **Cancels**
- Every cancel or reject through `cancelOrder` → `transitionOrder` now updates the status and calls `markPreBillsCancelledTx` (with the approving manager) in one transaction. Nothing is sent to the POS.
- `cancelOrder` takes `approverId`, which defaults to the actor, and records it in the audit row.
- It also calls `postCancelledTicketUnwind` (money-followups fix item 1).

(5) **Manager-only voids**
- New exported `requireManagerApproval` in pos/service.ts.
- `voidOrderItem`: every void needs a manager, so the cashier cap is effectively 0. The manager cap still applies (`OVER_CAP` / `OVER_MANAGER_CAP`), and `approverId` is always recorded.
- POST /orders/:id/cancel now allows CASHIERS roles plus a manager PIN of the same company. Errors are `MANAGER_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_MANAGER_PIN`; a foreign order returns 404 before any PIN is checked.
- Refused-at-door on a till (`source pos`) order needs a manager too.

(6) **Payments**
- processPayment, settlePayment and refundOrder now accept the card-machine fields (terminalChargeId, gateway card_terminal, authCode, cardBrand, cardLast4, manualReason) and store them in gatewayMeta.
- `assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx` runs under the order lock in processPayment, settlePayment (till), compOrder, applyGiftCardTender and prepareSplitTx (both split routes). Shift close calls `assertShiftHasNoActiveCharges`.
- The /pos/payments route accepts only `manualReason: 'terminal_offline'` from a client, and audits it as `terminal.manual_reference`. `gateway: 'card_terminal'` sent by a client is rejected (400).
- Till responses now carry `fiscal` plus the deprecated `srb` alias.
- `assertRefundAllowed` is exported, and connectors/terminal/service.ts now uses it instead of its own copies (`assertCardRefundPolicy` / `assertCardRefundable` removed). The check runs under the order lock, and amount errors are mapped to 409 `AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE` so the terminal API contract is unchanged.
- The gift-card fallback branch and the `GiftCardEngine` type were removed (money-followups build item 1).

(7) **Receipts**
- Receipt-data and the HTML receipt return 409 `PRE_BILL_REQUIRED` for an open order. Completed and refunded orders print; cancelled orders still print a CANCELLED slip with no heading and no fiscal block.
- New fields: `kind`, `heading` ('FULL & FINAL BILL'), `servdRef`, `fiscal` (FiscalView or `legacy`; a `prefiled_direct` skip is shown as legacy), `notTaxInvoice`, and `card`.
- The headline number is the fiscal number only when filed and not a test, with "Ref" showing the TaxInvoice number.
- HTML fiscal block:
  - filed: the number plus a real QR via `renderQrSvg`, and any extra authority numbers;
  - test: 'TEST — NOT A FISCAL INVOICE';
  - pending or failed: the pending line, no number;
  - legacy: the old lines plus a QR.
- The block is gated by `showFbrInvoice`, except 'Not a tax invoice', which always prints.
- The legacy fbr/srb keys are filled only from a filed, non-test number, otherwise from the order's own columns, so old tablets never print a TEST number as real.

(8) **keenuSettle** only acts on `keenu` rows or legacy `none` rows without a terminalChargeId. The REFUNDED path now merges into the row's existing meta instead of overwriting it.

(9) **Removals**
- Deleted adapters/fbr, adapters/srb, workers/fbrSubmission.ts and workers/srbSubmission.ts.
- Removed `getFbrQueue`, `getSrbQueue` and their job types from lib/queue.ts.
- Rewrote the compliance section of adapters/README.md.

Also applied: the build-LEFT tip ceiling in ingestOrder (payment plus wallet share).

The full backend suite was run as instructed, against servd_test_w4 and redis db 7, with no file filter: 100 files passed, 1397 tests passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed (exit 0). `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` is clean.

New test files:
- **tests/fiscalTill.test.ts** (19 tests).
  - Till bounded attempt: the `ok` scenario returns the number, and `srb` is null for a test number; the `slow` scenario returns within baseline + syncTimeoutMs + 500 ms with the payment committed and fiscal pending.
  - A driver that throws never fails the payment.
  - A forced database error inside the claim transaction leaves the sale completed, the pre-bill converted, and an ExceptionFlag `fiscal_failed`.
  - A replayed payment returns the same fiscal document.
  - Exactly one sale document for each door: till, comp, check-split group bill, Keenu callback, expo_handoff, rider_delivered, otp_verified, status_update. A completeOrder replay adds none.
  - Pre-bill twice + payment + completion gives exactly one sale document, with the pre-bills superseded then converted.
  - Pre-bill + cancel with a manager PIN gives zero documents, and the pre-bill shows `cancelledById` = that manager.
  - Two partial refunds give two refund documents that wait for the sale, and no `void:` remainder.
  - A line voided before completion gets its refund document at completion.
  - §17.7: company B not required gets zero documents (sale and refund) and `notTaxInvoice`; B required with no POS gets a `held` document in B's company; B gets 404 on A's order.

findings.title: A line voided on a paid, still-open order is taken off the fiscal filing twice: once in the sale's lines and again by the return document that completion adds
findings.scenario:
This was reproduced in /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/review-w4/fiscal.test.ts (F1), on DB servd_test_w4_fiscal with Redis db 3.

Setup: an online takeout order with 2 x Kheer at 550.00, tax 165.00, total 1,265.00, paid in full by card and still preparing. A manager voids one Kheer. voidOrderItem (TILL-R3) refunds 632.50 and deliberately does NOT lower the bill.

At expo hand-off, completeOrder builds the sale document:
- buildFiscalSaleTx only reads non-voided items, so the lines show 1 Kheer (taxable 550).
- The totals still use the stored order figures: taxCents 16,500 and totalCents 126,500.
- So the sale document disagrees with itself: lines plus tax come to 715, but the total says 1,265, and the whole 165 of tax sits on the single line.
- W4's new early-refund loop (lines 1706-1719) then queues a refund document of 632.50 behind the sale. It is spread over the remaining line and returns another 550 of taxable value.

Result with the reference SRB mapping (toSrbInvoiceFields): the sale's saleValue is 550 and the return's saleValue is 550, so the net filed is 0. The customer kept and paid for one Kheer (550 ex-tax). The FBR mapping files line items that don't add up to TotalBillAmount, with a credit note on top.

Two more effects:
- buildRefundPayload also assigns this void refund a pro-rata share of any tip, although the void amount (removedCents) never contains tip. That further understates the returned taxable value.
- Before W4 the SRB filer filed only the remaining lines and no return, which was correct. This is a regression from the cutover.
- The builder's test (fiscalTill 'a line voided on a paid order before completion…') checks only that the refund document exists, not the figures.
findings.fix:
Make the sale and the early return describe the same thing. Either:
(a) in buildFiscalSaleTx, include voided lines whose value was refunded instead of lowered: an OrderItem with voidedAt that is referenced by a refund Payment's gatewayMeta.refund.voidedItemId. The sale then lists what was charged and the early return document takes the line off once; or
(b) keep the sale lines without the voided line, lower the sale document's totals (tax, total) by the early refunds, and do NOT enqueue the early refund documents in completeOrder.

Also, for a refund that comes from a void (voidedItemId set), pass the tip share as 0 to buildRefundPayload. Its amount is pure line value.

Add a regression test asserting:
- sum(sale lines taxable + tax) + service + tip == sale totals.totalCents;
- net taxable (sale minus returns) == the value of the lines the customer kept.

findings.title: A completed sale can end up with no fiscal sale document and no way to recover; its later refunds are then auto-skipped and never filed
findings.fix:
1. In the savepoint failure branch, insert a minimal sale row so the sale stays visible and filable: same key `sale:<orderId>`, status manual_required (or held), statusReason 'enqueue_failed', with a payload built best-effort or empty and the amount set to the order total. 'Record manual filing' and a later release then work. Alternatively, give IT a route that re-runs enqueueFiscalSaleTx for an order whose claim exists but whose sale document does not.
2. Add a sweep (in the fiscal worker, per company) for orders in status completed or refunded with no 'order.complete' audit claim, or with fiscalReportingRequired and no sale document. It should run completeOrder for them, or raise `fiscal_failed`, so a failed claim never stays silent.
3. In enqueueFiscalRefundTx, when the company requires reporting, the order is completed or refunded, and no sale document exists, make the refund `waiting` with a flag instead of `skipped / no_sale_document`. Keep `no_sale_document` only for pre-connector history (completedAt before the cutover or liveSince).
4. In buildReceiptData, when the company requires reporting and the order has no sale document, print the 'Fiscal invoice: pending' line.
5. Add a test that injects a claim-transaction error (for example the audit_logs trigger used in the sim) and asserts that the order is eventually filed or flagged.

findings.title: A fully paid order that is not yet completed (online order paid by card or Keenu, before hand-off) can print neither a bill nor a pre-bill, and each endpoint points to the other
findings.scenario:
This was reproduced in .sim/review-w4/fiscal.test.ts (F3) with a storefront takeout order, status preparing, paid in full by card.
- `GET /pos/orders/:id/receipt-data` returns 409 `PRE_BILL_REQUIRED` "This order isn't paid yet — print a pre-bill". assertFinalBill only accepts the completed, refunded, cancelled and rejected statuses.
- `POST /pos/orders/:id/pre-bill` returns 409 `ALREADY_FINAL` "This order is fully paid — print the full & final bill instead".

The admin /orders 'Reprint receipt' button (frontend/admin/src/app/orders/page.tsx) and the tablet printer hit this dead end for every paid online order until the hand-off. Spec §17.1 defines the FnF bill as the bill of a "fully paid / completed order", and the message wrongly tells staff the order is unpaid.
findings.fix:
In assertFinalBill or buildReceiptData, treat an order whose paid tenders cover the bill (the same `covered >= total − rounding` rule as applyCoverageTx) as final. Print it with heading FULL & FINAL BILL and the fiscal line 'Fiscal invoice: pending — filed automatically' until completion creates the document. Never fall through to the TaxInvoice number as a fiscal number.

At minimum, make the 409 message for a paid order say that the bill is available after hand-off, instead of "isn't paid yet — print a pre-bill". Add a test covering both endpoints on a paid, not-yet-completed online order.

findings.title: Terminal charge on a pending row is recorded at the row's current amount, not the amount charged to the card (no amount check, no alert)
findings.scenario:
I reproduced this in .sim/review-w4/money2.test.ts (DB servd_test_w4_money, Redis db 4).

1. Take an online takeout order with a pending card Payment of 1,188.00.
2. The cashier starts a card-machine charge on that row: POST /pos/terminal/charges with paymentId set. TerminalCharge.amountCents is 118800.
3. While the machine waits, staff apply a 500.00 gift card through POST /gift-cards/redeem. That is the non-till path: redeemGiftCard → redeemGiftCardTx → lowerBillTx. It has no assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx, so the pending row drops to 688.00.
4. The card is approved for 1,188.00. recordCharge calls settlePayment({ paymentId: targetPaymentId, terminalChargeId }). settlePayment marks the row paid at its locked amount, 68800, and never compares it with the charge.

Result: the charge shows `recorded` 118800 and the payment shows `paid` 68800 card_terminal. The customer was charged PKR 500 more than was booked. Nothing is reversed, no exception is raised and no alert is sent.

loyalty adjustOrderBill (POST /loyalty/redeem) also lowers pending rows with no lock and no guard, so it is a second way in. The processPayment path is protected by its AMOUNT_MISMATCH check; the settle path has no equivalent.

findings.title: Terminal setting allowManualRef=false is enforced only in the UI; a cashier can still record card sales with an invented reference
findings.scenario:
Reproduced in .sim/review-w4/money.test.ts.

1. Company A's terminal connector has driver test, is enabled and online, and has settings.allowManualRef=false. GET /pos/terminal/config confirms allowManualRef:false.
2. A cashier posts to POST /pos/payments with { method:'card', amountCents: due, gatewayRef:'MADE-UP-123' }. The response is 201: the payment is paid, gateway 'none', the sale completes and files.
3. Sending manualReason:'terminal_offline' while the machine is online is also accepted.

`allowManualRef` is read only in connectors/terminal/service.ts terminalConfigForShift for the UI. Nothing in processPayment, settlePayment (POST /pos/payments/:id/settle, /check-split/payments/:id/settle) or the pos route checks it.

This leaves the classic skim open: the customer pays cash, the cashier records 'card' with a fake slip number and pockets the cash. The drawer still balances, and only the processor settlement reconciliation catches it later.
findings.fix:
1. In processPayment and settlePayment (via 'till'), for a card or keenu_qr tender that does not carry a server-supplied terminalChargeId:
   - load the order company's terminal connector (getConnector(tenantId,'terminal'));
   - if it is usable (enabled, driver ≠ none, has an active terminal) and settings.allowManualRef === false, refuse with 403/409 MANUAL_CARD_REF_DISABLED.
2. Decide whether the manualReason 'terminal_offline' path should still be honoured when allowManualRef is false. If it is, at minimum require a manager PIN for it.
3. Add a two-company test: company A has the setting off and is refused; company B has it on and is allowed.

findings.title: Manual refund route ignores card-machine refunds in flight, so the same card money can be refunded twice
findings.scenario:
Reproduced in .sim/review-w4/money.test.ts.

1. A card_terminal sale of 1,188.00 is recorded.
2. A manager starts POST /pos/terminal/refunds for the full 1,188.00. The refund charge goes to 'sent' and waits for the card.
3. Before it completes, POST /pos/orders/:id/refund { method:'card', amountCents:118800 } is accepted with 200. refundOrder computes refundable only from Payment rows and never counts unbooked TerminalCharge kind='refund' rows. The order becomes 'refunded'.
4. The machine refund is approved. recordRefund → refundOrder refuses with ALREADY_REFUNDED, and the charge goes to needs_attention.

The card was refunded by the machine and a second card refund was booked by hand: the same money went back twice. Only an after-the-fact alert catches it.

startTerminalRefund counts manual refunds through assertRefundAllowed. The reverse check is missing, so the two refund paths are not unified.
findings.fix:
In refundOrder (and refundDueOnCancelledTicket), inside the transaction after lockOrderTx:
1. Sum TerminalCharge rows with kind='refund', orderId = this order, paymentId null, status in [pending, sent, approved, cancel_requested, unknown, needs_attention], excluding input.terminalChargeId (the charge being booked).
2. Pass that sum as in-flight to the same refundable computation, as assertRefundAllowed already does.
3. Better: have refundOrder and assertRefundAllowed share one helper that takes the in-flight sum, so there is no second copy.
4. Optionally refuse a manual card refund of a gateway='card_terminal' payment while any refund charge on the order is active (409 REFUND_IN_PROGRESS).

findings.title: Line void and whole-order cancel are allowed while a card-machine charge is active
findings.scenario:
Reproduced in .sim/review-w4/money.test.ts.

1. A till order has an active charge for its full card total (status sent).
2. A manager voids a line: POST /pos/orders/:id/void returns 200.
3. A cashier cancels the order with the manager's PIN: POST /orders/:id/cancel returns 200.
4. The card is then approved. recordCharge → processPayment refuses ORDER_NOT_OPEN, the charge goes to void_pending, and it is reversed.

The customer's card is charged for a bill that no longer exists. Getting the money back depends entirely on the automatic reversal; if it fails (void_fails / vendor down) the charge ends in needs_attention.

The guard in voidOrderItem that is meant to stop this (PAYMENT_IN_PROGRESS, line ~1614) only looks for pending card/QR Payment rows. A card-machine charge creates no Payment row until it is approved, so the guard never fires.

cancelOrder / transitionOrder and refused-at-door take no order lock and do no active-charge check at all.
findings.fix:
1. In voidOrderItem, inside the transaction right after lockOrderTx, call assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx(tx, input.orderId).
2. In transitionOrder's cancel/reject transaction, take the order row lock (SELECT … FOR UPDATE) and call assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx before claimStatus. Either exempt the system auto-cancel sweep (onlyFrom set) or let it skip such orders.
3. Extend tests/terminalGuards.test.ts so void and cancel return 409 TERMINAL_CHARGE_ACTIVE.

findings.title: A line voided and refunded on a paid order before completion is returned twice to the fiscal POS (sale lines leave it out, then a separate return document returns it again)
findings.scenario:
Reproduced in /home/user/servd/backend/.sim/review-w4/w4regr.test.ts on DB servd_test_w4_rv.

Setup: an online card-paid takeout order of 2 x Kheer, 126,500 total including 16,500 GST, status preparing. A manager voids one Kheer. Because the bill is fully paid, voidOrderItem takes the refund branch: it writes a refund Payment of 63,250 (gatewayMeta.refund.voidedItemId) and leaves order.totalCents and taxCents unchanged. The order then completes at the expo hand-off.

In completeOrder, enqueueFiscalSaleTx builds the sale with buildFiscalSaleTx. That excludes items with status 'voided', but totals come from the order. The result is lines = 1 Kheer (taxable 55,000) while totals.taxCents = 16,500 and totals.totalCents = 126,500, so lines (taxable + tax) = 71,500 against a total of 126,500. The early-refund loop then also enqueues a refund document of 63,250 for that same Kheer.

As mapped to the authorities:
- toSrbInvoiceFields(sale) gives saleValue 550, netAmount 632.5. SRB therefore records a sale of 632.50 and then a return of 632.50: zero net sales, although the customer paid for and kept 632.50 of food.
- toFbrInvoiceFields gives TotalBillAmount 1265 against Items totalling 715. A strict vendor or PRAL validation rejects it, and the sale goes to 'rejected'.

The existing fiscalTill test for this case only checks that both documents exist, not that their contents are consistent. Every pre-completion refund comes from this void branch, so every early refund is affected. Online orders where the kitchen runs out of an item hit this path.
findings.fix:
Make the sale document list what was charged, with the return removing it.

Recommended (W1 file connectors/fiscal/payload.ts): in buildFiscalSaleTx, include voided lines that have a refund. These are lines whose id appears as gatewayMeta.refund.voidedItemId on one of the order's refunded Payments. With that, Σ(line taxable + tax) + service + tip = totalCents again, and the refund document enqueued in completeOrder returns that line.

Alternative (completeOrder only): skip early refunds whose gatewayMeta.refund.voidedItemId is set, and build the sale from totals reduced by those refunds. This needs the payload totals adjusted as well, so the first option is cleaner.

Add a test that, for both the sale and its refund, asserts Σ(lines.taxableCents + taxCents) + serviceChargeCents + tipCents === totals.totalCents, and that the sale total minus the refund total equals the amount the customer kept.

findings.title: A sale whose fiscal enqueue fails inside the completion claim gets no document and has no way to be retried or recorded
findings.scenario:
When the fiscal_sale savepoint in completeOrder (around line 1705) throws, the sale completes and an ExceptionFlag 'fiscal_failed' is raised. Example causes: buildFiscalSaleTx throws on bad data, a lock or statement error, or a bug in fiscalConnectorTx.

The flag's text says "File it by hand or ask IT to re-run it", but neither is possible:
- No FiscalDocument row exists. The sweeper, retryDocument, POST /pos/orders/:id/fiscal/retry, POST /connectors/fiscal/documents/:id/manual and releaseHeld all start from an existing document.
- No route or worker creates a missing sale document for an order that is already completed. legacyDrain only covers orders found in the old BullMQ queues, and it runs once.

The sale is therefore never sent to the fiscal POS. 'Record manual filing' cannot be used for it. It is absent from /health counts and from the Submissions list, so it can only be found by reading the exceptions inbox.
findings.fix:
In the failure branch, insert a fallback sale document in its own savepoint: kind 'sale', key `sale:<orderId>`, status 'failed', statusReason 'enqueue_failed', with a minimal payload rebuilt later. It then shows in Submissions and /health and can be retried or manually filed.

Alternatively, add a sweeper step that, for companies where fiscalReportingRequired is true, finds completed or refunded orders with an 'order.complete' audit row and no sale document, and calls enqueueFiscalSaleTx again.

Keep the ExceptionFlag. Add a test where a forced failure is followed by recovery and the sale ends up with exactly one document.

findings.title: Receipts for held sales say 'filed automatically, ask for a reprint for the QR'. Every sale is held from deploy until go-live, so this is wrong for weeks
findings.scenario:
From this deploy until the CEO takes a company live, every completion creates a held (no_connector) sale document (prodNotes 2). viewStatusOf maps held to 'pending'.

fiscalBlockHtml's default branch then prints "Fiscal invoice: pending — filed automatically. Ask for a reprint for the verification QR." on every customer bill from Monday. tablet/src/lib/printer.ts fiscalLines prints the same text.

Nothing will be filed and no QR will appear on a reprint until go-live. Customers who come back for a reprint get the same line.

The admin till already tells held apart (tillApi isFiscalHeld uses rawStatus), so the screen and the printed bill disagree.
findings.fix: In fiscalBlockHtml, check f.rawStatus === 'held' (FiscalView carries rawStatus and statusReason) and print a neutral line such as "Fiscal invoice: not yet issued" without the promise of a QR. Make the same change in tablet printer.ts fiscalLines. Add a receipt test for a held document.

findings.title: The admin Orders list still shows 'Reprint' on open till orders; it now gets 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED and shows a misleading alert
findings.scenario:
The Reprint button (line ~424) shows when `order.source === 'pos' || completed || cancelled`, so it also appears on open till tickets (received, preparing, ready).

reprintReceipt (lines 14-31) fetches /api/v1/pos/receipt/:id. That now answers 409 PRE_BILL_REQUIRED for open orders, and the page shows alert('Receipt not available for this order') with no offer to print a pre-bill.

The order detail page and PaymentModal handle isPreBillRequired correctly. Only this list page does not.
findings.fix: Show the button only for final statuses (completed, refunded, cancelled, rejected). Alternatively, reuse tillApi fetchReceiptHtml / isPreBillRequired and offer printPreBill on a 409, as orders/[id]/page.tsx does.

fix.summary:
I checked all 11 W4 findings against the code. I fixed 8 with tests. RG-4 and RG-5 are real, but every file they touch belongs to someone else, so they are in needsOtherFiles. For W4-AUTH-2, I rejected only one part: blocking keyed Keenu QR. I rejected none of the findings outright.

FIXED:
- **W4-FISCAL-1 / W4-RG-1 (high, confirmed).** A line voided on a paid order before completion was filed as removed twice. The sale left the line out while its totals still included it, and the return then removed it again.
  - This fix needed two W1 files outside my list: connectors/fiscal/payload.ts and outbox.ts. The defect cannot be fixed from my files, and no other agent is editing connectors/.
  - payload.ts `buildFiscalSaleTx` now also lists voided lines that were refunded (the refund Payment's gatewayMeta.refund.voidedItemId). The sale now shows what was charged and adds up to its own total.
  - `buildRefundPayload` takes an optional `tipShareCents`. When it is given, the tax and service shares are pro rata of the sale without the tip.
  - `enqueueFiscalRefundTx` passes `tipShareCents` through. `promoteWaitingRefunds` keeps a tip share of 0 for void refunds when it rebuilds (new `isVoidRefund`).
  - completeOrder's early-refund loop moved into the shared `enqueueSaleDocumentsTx`, which queues void refunds with `tipShareCents: 0`.
  - Tests: each document adds up to its total (Σ lines + service + tip = total), net taxable = the kept line, and the SRB saleValue nets to 550. A tipped-order case and the rebuild-on-promote case are covered too.
- **W4-FISCAL-2 / W4-RG-2 (confirmed).** A completed sale could end up with no sale document, and nothing recovered it.
  - New in orders/service.ts:
    - `completionRecoverySince()`: a Setting `orders.completionRecoverySince`, written once at first boot (index.ts), so orders from before the outbox are never re-completed or filed late.
    - `recoverOrderCompletion()`:
      - a completed order with no 'order.complete' claim → completeOrder via the new CompletionVia 'recovery';
      - a claimed order in a company that reports sales but has no sale document → `enqueueSaleDocumentsTx` under the order lock, and its fiscal_failed flag is resolved;
      - an order refunded before its completion ever ran → one fiscal_failed flag, never re-completed;
      - a recovery that fails again → flagged (one open flag per order).
    - `recoverIncompleteCompletions()`: one run takes up to 100 orders, at most 7 days back and at least 2 minutes old, with optional tenantIds. index.ts runs it every 2 minutes under ENABLE_WORKERS.
  - `enqueueSaleDocumentsTx` adopts returns that were auto-skipped as `no_sale_document` (sets saleDocumentId and makes them waiting), so a return taken in the gap is still filed.
  - The savepoint-failure flag now says servd retries automatically.
  - The receipt prints "pending" when a completed sale has no document yet.
  - Tests: claim transaction failing (audit_logs trigger), sale enqueue failing (mocked outbox), refunded-without-completion, and a two-company sweep.
  - I did not build the optional fallback sale row: it would be retried with an empty payload.
- **W4-FISCAL-3 (confirmed).**
  - receipt.ts `isFinalBill`/`assertFinalBill` treat paid > 0 && paid ≥ total as final. That is the same rule the pre-bill uses to refuse with ALREADY_FINAL, so the two endpoints no longer point at each other.
  - The bill prints FULL & FINAL BILL with an `AwaitingFiscal` block (status pending, statusReason awaiting_completion | not_queued, no number). The 409 message now says "isn't fully paid yet".
  - A refunded voided line prints as "(refunded)" so the lines add up to the TOTAL.
- **W4-RG-3 (confirmed).** A held document now prints "Fiscal invoice: not yet issued." with no QR promise. The tablet printer change is in needsOtherFiles.
- **W4-MONEY-1 (confirmed).**
  - New `assertChargeMatchesTx` in pos/service.ts, run under the order lock in both settlePayment and processPayment when a terminalChargeId is present.
  - It checks: the charge is this order's and this company's; it is in a recordable status; it is not already recorded; the target row matches; amount and tip match.
  - On a mismatch it answers 409 AMOUNT_MISMATCH, and the terminal service then reverses the charge.
  - Recordable statuses include unknown, cancel_requested and needs_attention, because resolveTerminalCharge records from those. The reviewer's "approved/manual_resolved only" would have broken that path.
  - The gift-card and loyalty guard (item 3) is in giftCards/loyalty files, so it is in needsOtherFiles.
- **W4-AUTH-2 (confirmed).**
  - New `assertManualCardRefAllowed`, called by processPayment and by settlePayment at the till (/pos and check-split). It uses the same "machine is set up for this drawer's outlet" rule as /pos/terminal/config.
  - A keyed card reference is refused with 403 MANUAL_CARD_REF_DISABLED, including manualReason 'terminal_offline'.
  - Partly rejected: Keenu QR is not blocked, because the card machine cannot take QR payments and the spec's switch covers card only.
  - Two-company test added.
- **W4-MONEY-3 (confirmed).**
  - New exported `inFlightTerminalRefundCents` plus `withInFlight`. refundOrder counts card refunds still in flight on the machine, both in its pre-check and under the order lock, excluding the charge being booked.
  - startTerminalRefund now uses the same helper (with needs_attention included); this was the one allowed terminal/service.ts edit. The manual route leaves needs_attention out on purpose: its alert asks staff to book that refund by hand.
  - Cancelled tickets cannot start a machine refund, so refundDueOnCancelledTicket did not need the count.
- **W4-MONEY-4 (confirmed).**
  - voidOrderItem calls assertNoActiveTerminalChargeTx right after the order lock.
  - transitionOrder's cancel/reject transaction now takes the order lock and runs the same guard. The auto-cancel sweep catches the error and retries on its next tick.
  - The old terminalGuards test that expected a void during a charge to succeed now expects 409. Its AMOUNT_MISMATCH reversal case is now triggered by an item added outside the till.

fix.prodNotes:
1. **Recovery marker.** On first boot, the API writes Setting `orders.completionRecoverySince` = boot time. The recovery sweep (every 2 minutes under ENABLE_WORKERS) only looks at orders completed or claimed after that time and within the last 7 days, so history is never re-completed. Do not delete this row: deleting it moves the window forward. Recovered or flagged runs log as `[complete] recovery: …`.
2. **Behaviour changes staff will see.**
   - **Card machine charging:** while it charges a bill, a line void and an order cancel return 409 TERMINAL_CHARGE_ACTIVE. Staff must finish or cancel the charge first. The auto-cancel sweep skips such orders until the charge is final.
   - **allowManualRef OFF:** if the CEO switches it off for a company that has a terminal at the outlet, keyed card slips are refused with 403 MANUAL_CARD_REF_DISABLED, even when the machine is offline. Cash and Keenu QR still work. The default is ON, so nothing changes until someone switches it off.
   - **Manual card refunds:** these are refused for any amount the card machine is still refunding.
   - **Paid online orders:** a fully paid online order can print its full & final bill before hand-off, with "Fiscal invoice: issued when the order is completed".
3. **Held sales.** Until a company goes live, every sale is held and its bill says "Fiscal invoice: not yet issued." The tablet still prints the old "pending … reprint" text until printer.ts is updated (needsOtherFiles 2).
4. **Fiscal payload changes.**
   - Sale documents for orders with a voided and refunded line now include that line; the return document removes it once.
   - Held sale documents created before this deploy are rebuilt from the order when released, so they pick up the fix automatically.
   - Waiting returns are rebuilt from their sale when it files, with a tip share of 0 for void refunds.
5. **Still pending from W4-needs.** Unchanged: SERVD_SECRET_KEY must be on the box, and the saved RoleModuleAccess rows need the new module grants (the boot step applies them once).
